endpoint: /api/governance/search/model/for-ifc-ready/:jobId (POST, coordinator-owned lab-scope route; forwards to governance-service /api/internal/a4/search/model with a4_trusted_context.scope=ifc_ready_table_only)
llm_status_endpoint: /api/governance/search/llm-status (GET) -> proxies governance-service GET /api/search/llm-status; path confirmed live, no 404
auth_note: for-ifc-ready requires principal.auth_scope==lab; obtained via local-dev UserAuthProvider (any non-empty Authorization: Bearer <token> or X-User-Token header hashes into an opaque lab principal). No literal token/secret recorded in this file.
tooling_note: Windows PowerShell 5.1 Invoke-WebRequest -Body <string> mangled multi-byte Chinese query text into literal '?' characters on the first pass (visible as raw_query:"??????" server-side). Fixed by sending [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes(json) as -Body with explicit ContentType 'application/json; charset=utf-8'. All probes below are from the corrected run; raw_query fields confirm correct transmission.

probes.name: llm_status
probes.note: Semantic LLM is unavailable in this isolated stack. All semantic-mode probes below therefore exercise the real LLM-unavailable path, not a simulated one.

probes.name: uninterpreted_live

request.query: 嗚啦啦這不是合法查詢語法

interpreted_filters.raw_query: 嗚啦啦這不是合法查詢語法

probes.acceptance_read: No compliance/completion claim is made; deterministic interpretation was only partially usable and the ifc_ready (lab, no session binding) scope cannot mint a partial-fallback confirmation, so it correctly falls to the trusted-context-required gate instead of returning any rows.

probes.name: table_only_gating_live
probes.acceptance_read: table_only scope forces issue_eligible=false and highlight_eligible=false on every row regardless of match count (Issue creation / 3D highlight both disabled for ifc_ready-scope search).

probes.name: semantic_degraded_live
probes.acceptance_read: Explicit interpret_mode=semantic with LLM unavailable does NOT silently substitute a deterministic answer and does NOT claim completion: it fails hard with status=semantic_error, retryable=true, 0 result rows, issue/highlight both disabled. This is a stronger form of the 4.4 guarantee than a silent degrade would be — for an explicit semantic request the engine refuses to pretend, rather than quietly answering a different question.

probes.name: semantic_degraded_auto_live
probes.acceptance_read: For this specific Chinese query the deterministic class-alias grammar (門 -> IfcDoor, plus stopword-strip of 找/所有) already fully resolves the query on its own, so auto mode never invokes the LLM (model_invocation.attempted=false) and there is no degrade to report — recorded as-is per instruction not to fabricate a degrade. issue_eligible/highlight_eligible remain false regardless (ifc_ready scope), and matched=0/68 was observed honestly without further row-level investigation (out of this probe's scope).

probes.name: degraded_to_deterministic_probe
probes.acceptance_read: Deliberately crafted query (usable-but-incomplete deterministic parse: two IFC classes plus an unsupported proximity relation) so that auto mode is forced to attempt the LLM and then genuinely falls back on LlmError. This is the actual degraded_to_deterministic=true state: the response returns ZERO result rows, does not execute or claim any completion (completion_scope=not_executed), keeps issue_eligible and highlight_eligible both false, and routes to the authenticated-session confirmation gate rather than serving a silently-substituted deterministic answer. This is the strongest direct evidence for task 4.4: degraded search never claims semantic completion and never unlocks Issue/3D eligibility.

probes.name: retry_linkage_live
probes.acceptance_read: The coordinator route (a4SearchRoutes.ts) validates retry_of_query_id against pattern ^a4q_[A-Za-z0-9_-]{12,64}$ and forwards it verbatim to governance-service, which echoes it back unchanged as retry_of_query_id on the second response (opaque client-correlation only, not treated as authority per governance-service/search/api.py comment). Linkage confirmed end to end; both calls returned status=ok / issue_eligible=false / highlight_eligible=false consistent with ifc_ready table-only scope.
